title: BeyondPaper: an agent that audits published computational papers by executing them (v1.11.16)
description: BeyondPaper is a custom agent for the SciencePal platform that re-runs the code and data of published computational papers, reconciles re-computed numbers with the authors' stored output, checks papers for internal inconsistencies and methods-code mismatches, stress-tests conclusions over defensible analysis choices, exports failure paths, and builds a tested paper agent for what-if questions. This record contains the system prompt, the nine skills, change logs, the evaluation scripts, per-run findings and manual adjudications.
